title: The Call
source_seed: Patron of seafarers + recognising the devoted (the mother who answers)
caption_hook: Before every crossing, they called her name. She always turned.

shots.camera: Eye level, front-facing, three-quarter-length framing from the reference portrait, with one slow, small push-in throughout and the crown and golden sun disc centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her stern gaze holds the viewer, then the bright star above Her crown flares once and Her head turns slowly to look out over the dark sea toward the horizon, as if answering a call. After a moment Her head turns back to the viewer and Her stern look eases into a faint, tender smile. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The star is the cause, her turn is the action, her softening is the answer: the goddess who hears the call before the voyage.
